eyebrow: Two operators, applied over and over

steps.label: Oracle: O|x⟩ = (−1)^f(x)|x⟩
steps.sub: Flips the sign on the marked state only — not a measurement, nothing read out

steps.label: Diffusion: D = 2|s⟩⟨s| − I
steps.sub: "Reflect about the mean" — new amplitude = 2·mean(a) − aᵢ

steps.label: Neither step alone changes P(marked)
steps.sub: A sign flip doesn't change |amplitude|² — the payoff is in combining them

steps.label: Geometrically: two reflections = one rotation
steps.sub: A fixed rotation by angle 2α, where sin(α) = 1/√N, toward the marked state

caption: One full Grover iteration on N=4: every unmarked amplitude goes to exactly zero. P(marked) = 1.0^2 = 1.0, deterministic success.

eyebrow: A rotation, not a one-shot trick

steps.label: A 2D plane: |marked⟩ and the unmarked axis
steps.sub: The starting state sits at angle α above the unmarked axis

steps.label: Oracle reflects about the unmarked axis
steps.sub: Flips the sign of the marked component only

steps.label: Diffusion reflects about the starting-state axis
steps.sub: Two reflections compose into one rotation

steps.label: Fixed rotation per iteration — not shrinking or growing
steps.sub: That fixed angle is exactly what drives the overshoot in Lesson 18

subtitle: Building these two operators from ordinary Hadamard and phase-flip gates.
